components.name: Processing Rosette and Steps
components.description: Turning abalone rosette disc and five in-place step bars.
components.css: :host{--ground:#f6efe3;--paper:#fbf8f2;--line:#e6dac6;--line-soft:#efe6d6;--pill:#efe6d6;--pill-now:#eadfcb;--ink:#2a1c13;--ink-2:#6f5643;--ink-3:#9a836e;--ink-4:#b39e88;--honey:#e5bf80;--honey-tint:#f3e2c2;--honey-line:#e6cb9b;--rose:#5a3522;--teal:#2f6b6a;--teal-tint:#dbe9e4;--teal-line:#c4dbd3;--abalone:conic-gradient(from 30deg,#2f6b6a,#77b5a9,#3d5378,#8f7bb5,#2f8f7f,#b9d7c4,#2f6b6a);--ui:'Schibsted Grotesk',system-ui,sans-serif;--lyric:'Hanken Grotesk','PingFang SC',sans-serif;--ease:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);} .ds-job{width:300px;} .ds-disc{width:112px;height:112px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--ink) 0 34px,var(--paper) 34px 36px,var(--ink) 36px 37.5px,transparent 37.5px),var(--abalone);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--paper),0 0 0 4px var(--line),0 18px 34px -16px rgb(70 40 15 / .45);animation:ds-turn 9s linear infinite;} .ds-steps{list-style:none;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:6px;margin-top:26px;} .ds-steps li{height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--line);} .ds-steps li.done{background:var(--teal);} .ds-steps li.now{background:var(--honey);animation:ds-breathe 1.6s var(--ease) infinite;} @keyframes ds-turn{to{rotate:1turn;}} @keyframes ds-breathe{50%{opacity:.45;}} @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-disc,.ds-steps li{animation:none;}}

narrative.overview:
The sheet is a quiet spruce-and-cream room where only the sung line and its playing chord carry colour. Everything is built from the materials of an acoustic guitar: a cream spruce ground, paper surfaces, rosewood ink, honey from the top's finish, and an abalone rosette that rings the play control and the processing disc. It refuses the chord site's dense monospace grid and its wall of toolbars.

Owner-pinned (2026-11-13): the Spruce Top & Rosette colours (cream ground, rosewood ink, honey for capo and loop, abalone teal for "now", abalone rosette ring), with the lightness of the Strum iOS app: small refined type, light pale lyrics with wide word gaps, borderless soft chord pills, and a floating player. Earlier, larger previews read as "clunky, big, out of space"; the system stays small and airy because of that. The owner also rejects a techy look (dark dashboard, neon), a busy look (panels competing with the sheet) and a plain look (generic web app with no guitar feel).

Density is low and the type is small: 13px UI, 11-11.5px labels, 16px light lyrics. Hierarchy comes from tone, not size. Upcoming lines sit pale; the current line darkens to ink; its playing chord alone turns teal.
keyCharacteristics: Cream ground, paper surfaces, rosewood ink in four steps, warm 1px hairlines.
Two accents with fixed jobs: honey means capo and loop, abalone teal means "now".
The abalone rosette ring is the only decorative device; it marks play and processing.
Light, pale lyrics with wide word gaps; small borderless chord pills above words.
A floating rounded player at bottom centre; no toolbars.

rules.name: The Two Jobs Rule
rules.body: Honey means capo and loop; teal means "now". Never swap them, and never use either as decoration.

rules.name: The One Coloured Chord Rule
rules.body: At most one chord on the sheet is teal at any moment: the one sounding now.

rules.name: The Small Type Rule
rules.body: Nothing but titles exceeds 17px. Hierarchy comes from weight and ink step, not size.

rules.name: The Pale Lyric Rule
rules.body: Lyrics are light weight and pale (`ink-4`), step to `ink-3` for the next line and to full `ink` at 400 for the current line. Chinese characters join without the word gap.

rules.name: The Only Things That Float Rule
rules.body: Only the player, the processing disc and the sounding chord carry a drop shadow.

dos: **Do** keep honey for capo and loop and teal for "now" (The Two Jobs Rule).
**Do** keep type small: 13px UI, 11-11.5px labels, 16px light lyrics, 26px titles.
**Do** draw hairlines as 1px `line` / `line-soft` and float only the player, disc and sounding chord.
**Do** use the abalone rosette only for play, the brand mark and processing.
**Do** draw icons as inline stroked SVG (1.4-1.8px strokes, round caps).
donts: **Don't** give chord pills borders or make them bigger: they stay borderless, 11px, 7px radius.
**Don't** add toolbars or panels around the sheet; controls live in the pill row and the floating player.
**Don't** go dark, neon or dashboard-like; don't add a monospace chord grid.
**Don't** copy the Strum app's logo, name styling or assets.
**Don't** invent logos, illustrations or photography; album art comes from the song source only.
